about: Modeler lesson M7 (scenarios, Monte Carlo and global sensitivity). The toy is case file CF7's waiting load (assets/learn/data/cf7-cost-of-waiting.json, idea), with invented ranges around CF7's values: illustrative round numbers, one price level, no inflation. The reference block holds the lesson's results, computed from the seeded runs; the lab notebook (learn/notebooks/m07-monte-carlo.ipynb) checks its answers against them.

dataset.creator: Honglin Li
dataset.status: Illustrative: invented ranges and round numbers around a toy waiting load; the runs are seeded simulations.
dataset.source: Prepared by hand for lesson M7; the runs are generated by the lesson's seeded Monte Carlo code from the seed in this file.

toy.title: One large load waits for the grid
toy.note: Illustrative round numbers, not the study's inputs, equations or results.

inputs.label: Margin once connected
inputs.why: [[margin|Margin]] = revenue minus operating costs, lost for every month of waiting.

inputs.label: Capital ready and idle
inputs.why: Buildings and equipment that sit idle; their [[carrying-cost|carrying cost]] is what the tied-up money would earn at the discount rate.

inputs.label: Discount rate
inputs.why: The yearly rate that turns future money into [[present-value|present value]]; it also sets the carrying cost.

inputs.label: Grid upgrades built for it
inputs.why: Paid by other customers while the load waits; [[stranded-cost|stranded]] (left without the expected customer) if it never arrives.

inputs.label: Chance it never arrives
inputs.why: Added each month of waiting, not compounded: 24 months × 0.5 points = 12%, at most 50%.

guess.label: About $235M: every input at its high-cost end

reference.about: Reference results, computed from the seeded runs. Dollars are present values; shares are fractions of the runs.
